rationale: The cited full context says the identified AI issues cannot currently be resolved prescriptively without architectural mitigation and retains an Air System Safety Case with verification, trials, testing, analysis and continuing performance monitoring in the stated circumstances. The claim confines that judgment to the MAA notice, rather than asserting that every jurisdiction lacks a prescriptive method.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-001-R3, MAA/RN/2025/04, PDF pp. 3-4, paragraphs 13-14, Non-Compliances and Summary
limitations: This is a regulator's current military-guidance judgment, not a survey finding about all civil regimes.
Architectural mitigation and evidence collection do not prove a particular learned system safe.
